releases.name: v1.1.1 — no runtime dependencies
releases.body:
## Fixed

- **Installing the plugin pulled in ~30 packages (62M).** `@opencode-ai/plugin` was a peer dependency, so npm installed it with its whole dependency tree for every user, although the plugin only imports a type from it. It is now a dev dependency: an install is the plugin alone (~20K). opencode checks `engines.opencode`, which is unchanged.

  This also removes the `toml` and `zod` advisories from installs, as neither package is installed anymore.

No behaviour changes.

releases.name: v1.1.0 — notifications work again
releases.body:
## Fixed

- **No notifications were sent when installed from npm.** opencode's npm loader takes the server entry from `exports["./server"]` or `main`; the package only declared `exports["."]`, so the plugin was skipped silently. Both are now declared. (#2, thanks @moegitree)
- **Notifications stopped on recent macOS.** The focus check (`osascript … first application whose frontmost is true`) fails with `-1728`, and the error was swallowed. Focus detection is removed: every notification is sent.
- **Permission notifications never fired** on opencode 1.19+, which no longer calls the `permission.ask` hook. The plugin now listens for the `permission.asked` event.
- **The body was sometimes your own prompt.** User messages are text parts too; only the assistant's reply is sent now.
- The title shows the folder name instead of `global` outside a git repository.

## Changed

- The `terminals` option is removed (it only fed focus detection).

## Update

```bash
rm -r ~/.cache/opencode/packages/@jack-yang/opencode-bark-notify*
# restart opencode
```

releases.name: v1.0.2 — Zero-token verification
releases.body: Published with npm Trusted Publishing (OIDC). NPM_TOKEN secret removed from repo — zero long-lived credentials.

releases.name: v1.0.1 — Switch to Trusted Publishing
releases.body:
Switch from NPM_TOKEN to npm Trusted Publishing (OIDC).

No code changes — pipeline only. Using the same OIDC-based authentication as PyPI trusted publishers, no long-lived token required.

releases.name: v1.0.0 — Focus-aware Bark notifications
releases.body:
Initial release.

## Features
- Focus-aware push notifications via Bark (suppress when terminal is frontmost)
- Detailed content: agent's last message (up to 500 chars)
- Category badges: ✅ Responded / 🔐 Wait for Permission / ❓ Input Needed
- Session title in notification title
- Configurable via plugin tuple or BARK_KEY env var
- Supports self-hosted Bark servers
- Zero dependencies (pure TypeScript, runs on Bun)
